featured_reviews.name: Kshitij Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text: Powai Lake is an artificial lake, situated in Mumbai, in the Powai valley, where a Powai village with a cluster of huts existed. The city suburb called Powai shares its name with the lake. Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, is located to the east of the lake. Another famous institution, the IIM Mumbai erstwhile known as National Institute of Industrial Engineering, is also located close to the lake. Housing complexes and plush hotels are developed all around the lake periphery. Population around the lake has thus substantially increased over the years. The Powai Lake has gone through many stages of water quality degradation. The lake water which used to supply drinking water for Mumbai has been declared unfit to drink. The lake remains a tourist attraction.

featured_reviews.name: Amar Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is a little paradise located in the middle of crowded city, Mumbai. The lake has panoramic view of Aarey jungle, Hiranandani towers & IIT Mumbai. The lake has boating facility as well & it's equipped with jogging track & garden.

During monsoon, the scenary of the lake is beyond imagination.

If you're visiting or living in Mumbai, this place should be in your top list. There are many good restaurants and pubs are located in the vicinity.

featured_reviews.name: Salman Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Went up cycling from Andheri West to Powai. Been one of the most pleasant rides to do. Really liked how we could go and Hiranandani Gardens is worth exploring as well. Just beautiful place.

featured_reviews.name: theindian shailesh
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place to spent time with friends. Beautiful view of Lake. Many types of birds can be seen. People come here to celebrate their birthdays. Also have place to practice dance. Nice spot for photography. Some people are throwing garbage in it. They must stop it.

featured_reviews.name: The Well Wisher
featured_reviews.review_text:
Whenever you pass through or halt at Powai Lake, it’s a divine feeling. Why? Because this is the only lake surrounded by urban jungle in Mumbai. When you pass through the heavy traffic jams in Mumbai before/after work and reach Powai. There is a sense of calmnness/stillness that you feel.

Definitely a great place to catch sunsets & experience monsoons

featured_reviews.name: Priyam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice place to hangout... Huge waterbody.... Gets cooler in the evenings....... Good for family, good for couples and also good for friends.........  These pictures are of a traditional north festival for which females come to the lake.. For bathing n worshipping...
No parking space available... Roadside parking can be done..

featured_reviews.name: Yogesh Kalgutkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Powai Lake is a calm and soothing place to enjoy nature at its best.There are so many luxurious hotels around the periphery of the lake.Powai Lake is an artificial lake and the hills surrounding it make it a nice place to relax.Boat riding facility is also available here which is quite a tranquil experience.Powai Lake Garden is also situated here where one can sit and enjoy the serenity of the surroundings.Here one can spot crocodiles, fisherman,spot-billed duck, small blue kingfisher, white-throated kingfisher, spotted dove,purple-rumped sunbirds, white browned bulbuls, peregrine falcon, woolly-necked stork etc.Wonderful place,and a good place for photography....Morning and Evening very nice place

featured_reviews.name: Rahull DDube
featured_reviews.review_text:
Be at the Lake view point entrance..In terms of Views in the morning time, quite pleasant and good with the sound of lot of birds.

The beautiful lake surrounded by high rise buildings gives a nice view.

Lot of pigeons every Sunday morning  come to take their feed " Chana" which is sold by one of the seller.. Pl bring at least 5kg to feed there are lot pigeons.

These pigeons come near your foot when u feed them and surround you.

Nice place to visit on Sunday morning ( only at lake view point).

featured_reviews.name: Digital Husaainsyed
featured_reviews.review_text: I am currently visiting this small garden near Powai Plaza and the place feels calm and refreshing. The pond with fishes adds a nice natural touch and makes the environment peaceful. It’s a good spot to sit for a while, relax and enjoy the surroundings in the middle of the busy Powai area. The garden is fairly clean and well maintained, and many people come here to spend some quiet time or take photos. Overall, a pleasant little place to relax around Powai Plaza.

featured_reviews.name: Vipul Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: Beautiful park. I hope BMC build and maintain parks like this not just at premium locations. This is different park from the commonly searched for Powai garden. This is not powai garden. Many people get confused between this park and the Powai garden. This is Nirvana Park. Please check location properly before visiting. Park is well maintained and I request everyone to not litter with chips bag, water bottles, etc. please act responsibly and throw your trash in dust bins.l

featured_reviews.name: Ramya Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a big nostalgic garden for me.I have been here as a child and as an adult. I still remember the days when this garden was handled by Hiranandani group, then handed over to BMC. Must-say, BMC has maintained this garden very well. There is a small pond inside the garden, boating is no longer available in this pond. There is a play area inside the garden. The garden space is tremendously huge. It is surrounded by a lot of trees. Very green space. Best time to visit is in the evening.

featured_reviews.name: ShriyaReviews
featured_reviews.review_text: its still a good get-together place for friends and family with a lot of space to move around. But, the level of water in the pond is quite low and difficult for the existing colorful fish to swim here. i usually see people coming here to either take a walk, draw, paint or to take photos for pre wedding or something of a similar sort. its a recycling water area and you can smell chlorine. also there is hakone right infront of this garden, we you can play games, rides, go cart, painball and lots more.

featured_reviews.name: Zaki Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: BMC Nirvana Park, Powai is a really nice place to hang out and relax. The atmosphere is peaceful, and it’s a good spot to chill with friends or just enjoy some quiet time. The only downside is that the fishes in the lake aren’t visible because the water looks quite dirty. Apart from that, it’s a pleasant and enjoyable place to visit.

featured_reviews.name: Dinesh Mahato
featured_reviews.review_text: As a FREE park, The park is very good, less number of crowd, lots of trees, fishes and 1 "TORTOISE", 😊You can spend a peaceful quality time there, but lots of COUPLES are also there 😊, Don't know about others but I fill uncomfortable 🥵. And main problem is "PEOPLES WITH LACK OF CIVIC SENCE ", you can find lots of plastic bottles and plastic packets here and there.. really SHAME on US.

featured_reviews.name: Kisa Kazmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
One can tell that the park used to be very beautiful and serene but just like everything else in our country, we Indians have not taken care of it. It should not say maintained by BMC, because there is zero maintenance.
It’s not just the government’s responsibility to keep something clean, we as citizens do have a responsibility of ensuring cleanliness which was massively lacking in this park.

featured_reviews.name: Suj Hande
featured_reviews.review_text: The park is not maintained properly. Water ponds are unclean, garbage is scattered everywhere, and shrubs are not taken care of. The toilet is in a dilapidated condition.

featured_reviews.name: Parimal Aglawe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing Place,
The studio owner is very friendly and flexible.
The equipment are high quality grade and the output is top notch. I personally have gotten a couple of mixes out from the studio and the quality is at par (which fortunately you won't have to worry about)
Here's how I would rate this place categorised in 4 avenues:
1. Recoding (8/10) : Best place to record your vocals, although I personally haven't tried recording any instrument here so I don't know about that, you can definitely ask the studio owner and check with him regarding the same.
2. Music Production (09/10): The guy knows what he is doing, the music ia unconventional and unique so if you're looking for something unique, you should check this out.
3. Mixing (10/10) : The studio is very well treated, what you'll hear inside is what you'll hear on majority of the audio systems, it translates very well.
4. Mastering (09/10) : Won't be able to check how it would translate on different audio systems, but if you know how to go about it, nothing like it. You can use Audified Mix Checker plugin if you don't know how the masters are going to sound of different audio systems.

All in all 5/5
Great place to record, produce, mix, master and chill. Good vibes.
